user.title: Connect to Trobar
user.description: Enter your Trobar server's URL and an integration token created at Profile → Integrations in the Trobar web UI (admin account required).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Trobar
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} was rejected — it may have been revoked. Tokens must now be created by an admin account (Profile → Integrations). Enter a replacement.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Trobar
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the token for {url}. A new address needs the token pasted again: the current token is never sent to a new address. With the same address, paste a new token, or leave it empty to keep the current one.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or revoked token. Create a new one at Profile → Integrations.
error.server_too_old: This Trobar server is older than 2.8.0, which doesn't have the integration API. Upgrade the server to continue.
error.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the server URL.
error.url_needs_scheme: Enter the full address, starting with https:// or http://. The token is sent to it on every update, and over http:// it travels unencrypted.
error.token_required_for_new_address: A new address needs the token pasted again. The current token is never sent to an address that has just been entered.

abort.already_configured: This Trobar server is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Trobar server's settings were updated.

init.title: Trobar options
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks the Trobar server for news, in minutes (1 to 60).

scan_library.name: Scan library
scan_library.description: Asks a Trobar server to rescan its music library. A scan already running counts as done.

force.name: Force
force.description: Re-read every file, not only those changed since the last scan.

scan_not_supported.message: This Trobar server is older than 2.9.0, which can't start a scan from Home Assistant.

token_rejected.message: The Trobar server rejected the token. It may have been revoked.

server_too_old.message: This Trobar server is too old for the integration API (2.8.0 or later is needed).

rate_limited.message: The Trobar server is rate-limiting this token. Try again in a few minutes.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Trobar server.

server_route_missing.title: Trobar server at {url}: no server entities
server_route_missing.description: The server answered 404 for its status route, so the server device's entities (reachability, scan running, version, tracks, library size, last scan and the Scan library button) aren't set up. Either the server is older than {version}, or a reverse proxy in front of it doesn't forward that path. Upgrade the server or fix the proxy, then reload the integration; this notice goes away once the route answers.

mirrors_route_missing.title: Trobar server at {url}: no mirror health entities
mirrors_route_missing.description: The server answered 404 for its mirrors route, so the mirror health entities aren't set up. Either the server is older than {version}, or a reverse proxy in front of it doesn't forward that path. Upgrade the server or fix the proxy, then reload the integration; this notice goes away once the route answers.

playlist_sources_route_missing.title: Trobar server at {url}: no playlist source health entities
playlist_sources_route_missing.description: The server answered 404 for its playlist sources route, so the playlist source health entities aren't set up. Either the server predates playlist source health, or a reverse proxy in front of it doesn't forward that path. Upgrade the server or fix the proxy, then reload the integration; this notice goes away once the route answers.
